title: Belgium Faces a Defining Budget Battle as Debt, Weak Growth · 16 Sep
keywords: Belgium, budget deficit, fiscal consolidation, EU fiscal rules, Belgian coalition, public debt, inflation, economic growth, austerity, European affairs
notes: Belgium's federal government is racing toward a mid-October deadline to present a credible plan for closing a budget shortfall estimated at roughly ten billion euros, a target that will face scrutiny in both parliament and Brussels. The stakes extend well beyond political survival: with public debt trending toward 114 percent of GDP and inflation still running above comfortable euro area levels, the choices made in the coming weeks will shape household finances, public services, and Belgium's standing in EU fiscal debates for years to come.
